summary.limitations: Text is the authored template: {path} bindings are listed but not resolved against the model, so the printed values are not included. Images and logos are metadata only (no pixels); charts give their definition, not their computed buckets; tables give their source, not their rows; validation and checklist blocks give the counts frozen when they were added. Text excerpts are bounded.
